jobs.title: Lead IATF Auditor - Contractor
jobs.reason: A "Lead" auditor role requiring specialist automotive quality-assurance expertise (IATF 16949, AIAG core tools, OEM requirements) that the candidate plainly lacks — both a senior title and an unmet essential technical qualification. The field is entirely outside the candidate's academic and interest profile.

jobs.title: Freelance Auditor ISO 14001
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers: it requires ISO 14001 Lead Auditor certification, a technical engineering/chemistry background, minimum 5 years of experience, and fluent Dutch — none of which the candidate meets. It is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Auditor Integrated Management Systems
jobs.reason: Requires a minimum of 5 years' industry experience plus a technical degree and expert knowledge of energy/environmental management systems — none of which the candidate has, and it exceeds the entry-level threshold. It also requires excellent written and spoken Dutch as an essential, which the candidate lacks. The role is entirely outside the candidate's interest areas and skill set.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert advisory-committee members, not a paid entry-level role; it seeks established experts (activists/practitioners from specific regions) and reads as an unpaid advisory / voluntary appointment, so it trips the "not a genuine paid role" and "not entry-level" disqualifiers. The human-rights subject is of interest, but the candidate lacks the expert standing and regional practitioner background sought.

jobs.title: Tutor - Freelancer
jobs.reason: The posting is a freelance sub-tutor role in Shanghai delivering courses, with no connection to the candidate's research, policy or international-law profile, and the sparse listing implies subject-matter expertise the candidate does not have. It falls outside all three interest zones and is not an on-profile paid role for this candidate.

jobs.title: Seafood Auditor - Global (ASC, BAP, MSC COC & MSC)
jobs.reason: Requires at least two years of relevant seafood/aquaculture/food-safety audit experience the candidate does not have, and the role demands domain expertise (farm or processing) entirely outside the candidate's background. It is also a self-employed contractor auditing role wholly unrelated to any interest zone.

jobs.title: Customer Service Advisor (6 months)
jobs.reason: The role requires 2-3 years of client-management experience as an essential and involves mentoring less experienced colleagues, placing it beyond entry-level for a candidate with only RA/student-assistant work. It is a customer-service / account-management role entirely outside the candidate's research, policy and geopolitical-risk interest zones.
